Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.

entry.title: Saraswati enthroned (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Saraswati enthroned (pictured) has been described as "a pinnacle of Indian art"?

entry.title: Dragostea din tei (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that O-Zone threatened legal action over Haiducii's cover of "Dragostea din tei", which became a hit on charts at the same time as the original?

entry.title: Gu Jiegang (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that historian Gu Jiegang secretly continued research into children's copybooks during the Cultural Revolution?

entry.title: a 1968 protest (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a 1968 protest at Bucks County Community College was one of only two gay-rights protests in the United States to occur on a college campus prior to the Stonewall riots?

entry.title: Marion Wiesel (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Marion Wiesel translated 14 of her husband's books from French?

entry.title: an enticement for them to resign (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the first-ever mass message to the U.S. government's two million employees was an enticement for them to resign?

entry.title: a Celtic god described by Caesar (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a Celtic god described by Caesar has been variously identified with a thunder god, a mallet god, a stag god, and a god with no name?

entry.title: a municipal merger in Japan (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a municipal merger in Japan failed after the merger council named the new city after an airport in a different city?

entry.title: Socialite Rank (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the anonymously run Socialite Rank and Rich Kids of Instagram were both compared to the fictional Gossip Girl?
